extName.message: Recorte — export selection as a file

extDescription.message: Select text, right-click and save it as .json, .xml or .txt, already formatted. 100% local, no network.

comandoExportar.message: Export the selection in automatic mode
comandoExportar.description: Descrição do atalho, vista em chrome://extensions/shortcuts

opcoesSubtitulo.message: Exports the page selection as a ready-formatted file.

opcoesAtalhoDescricao.message: Exports the selection in automatic mode, without opening the right-click menu.

opcoesAtalhoConflito.message: The suggested combination probably already belongs to another extension. Chrome does not warn you when that happens — it simply leaves the command without a key.

opcoesPorQue.message: The change happens on a Chrome page. No extension can set its own shortcut, and that is by design: it stops any of them from taking your keys without you seeing it.

opcoesLocalTexto.message: No network calls, no external libraries, no telemetry. The extension reads the page only at the moment you trigger the export, and the file is produced on your machine.
